h1: The 8 Best High Leg Recliners for Easier Sitting and Standing, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best High Leg Recliners 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 8 high leg recliners scored on seat height, lift assist, seat width, weight rating and warranty, from lift chairs to pushbacks.
summary: The REHOUSING Oversized Power Lift is the pick for large or tall sitters who need real lift assist, with a 26.5 inch seat and a 400 lb rating. The MCombo 7040 is the better value lift chair, the Korser is the roomiest rocker-swivel, and the ANJ leather pushback pair is the one to buy if you want a classic look on raised wooden legs. Skip the compact VKNOW unless floor space is your main problem.
intro: Most recliners fail the people who buy them in one specific moment: getting out. A low, sagging seat turns every stand-up into a push-off, and the knees pay for it. A high leg recliner solves that two ways. Either the whole chair rises on a motor, or the seat sits higher on exposed legs so your hips start closer to standing height.

We ranked eight recliners that fit that idea, from power lift chairs to pushbacks on wooden legs, working from the listed dimensions, weight ratings, mechanisms and support terms. Where a listing leaves out a number, such as seat height, we say so rather than guess. Scores follow the Primea framework, and every pick is judged on how easily a real person gets in, gets out and stays comfortable between.

products.name: REHOUSING Oversized Power Lift Recliner Big Man 400lbs, Extra Wide Recliner Chair with Lifts Vertically for Elderly, Features Cup Holder, Heat and Massage, Zero Gravity Lay Flat for Adults (Grey)
products.verdict: The widest seat and highest weight rating here, with a motor that does the standing up for you.
products.description:
The REHOUSING is a triple-motor power lift recliner with a 26.5 inch wide seat, 22.25 inch seat depth and a 31 inch backrest. It is rated to 400 lbs, lays flat in a zero gravity position, and adds heat, massage and armrest storage with cup holders.

It tops the list because lift assist is the purest answer to the high-leg problem. The seat rises and tips you toward standing instead of asking your thighs to do the work. Against the MCombo below it, you gain 50 lbs of rated capacity and a wider, deeper seat, but you pay for it in footprint at 39.5 by 44.5 inches overall.

Buy it if you are broad, tall or recovering from a knee or hip procedure and want one chair that handles every stage. The caveat is that the price bucket is $500 to $1,000 and the chair needs a wall outlet within reach.
products.idealFor: Larger or taller sitters who need real standing help.
products.skipIf: You have a small room or want a no-power chair.

products.name: MCombo Power Lift Recliner Chair for Elderly 7040(Medium, Light Brown) | Heat and Massage
products.verdict: A properly specified lift chair that costs far less than the oversized models.
products.description:
The MCombo 7040 pairs a counter-balanced lift mechanism and a TUV certified actuator with a two-button remote. It reclines to a maximum of 140 degrees, carries 350 lbs, and adds eight vibration points, one lumbar heat zone, two USB ports and two cup holders on a FSC certified wood frame.

It ranks second because it delivers the same stand-up assistance as the REHOUSING for a lower price bucket of $200 to $500. What you give up is room: the listing recommends users between 5 ft 1 in and 5 ft 9 in, and it stops at 140 degrees, so it never lays flat.

It suits average-height seniors and anyone who just wants a lift chair without paying for oversize extras. The USB ports are rated for low-power devices only, so charge a phone, not a laptop.
cons: Sized for 5 ft 1 in to 5 ft 9 in
USB ports limited to low-power devices
products.idealFor: Average-height users who want lift assist on a mid-range budget.
products.skipIf: You are over 5 ft 9 in or want a flat sleeping angle.

products.name: Korser Oversized Recliner Chair, Extra Wide Rocking Chair with Massage and Heat, 360° Swivel Rocker Recliner for Adults, Nursery Chair with Side Pocket, Cashmere Reclining Sofa for Living Room, Beige
products.verdict: Generous seat room plus swivel and rock, but no motor to help you stand.
products.description:
The Korser widens the inner seat to 26 inches by 22.5 inches, which is the same class of room as the REHOUSING, inside overall dimensions of 38.6 by 39.3 by 41 inches. It rocks, swivels 360 degrees, reclines from 110 to 160 degrees and carries eight vibration motors with lumbar heat in a double-sided cashmere-style fabric.

It sits below the two lift chairs because recline here is manual, so standing still relies on your legs. In exchange it is quieter in daily use, and it costs less than the REHOUSING while matching its seat width. The 65.1 inch fully reclined length also needs more floor than the MCombo.

It is the right call for broad sitters who value a swivel rocker for nursery or living room use. Unplug the massage cord before spinning it a full turn, because the cord can wind up.
cons: Massage cord can wind during spins
products.idealFor: Larger sitters who want a swivel rocker without lift motors.
products.skipIf: You struggle to stand from a seated position.

products.name: ANJ Genuine Leather Pushback Recliners for Adults, Wingback Recliners Set of 2
products.verdict: Two top-grain leather wingbacks on solid wood legs, priced as a pair.
products.description:
The ANJ listing is a set of two wingback pushbacks wrapped in top-grain genuine leather, sitting on solid wood legs and rated for 350 lbs each. The frame is described as passing a 25,000 cycle test, and the footrest extends when you lean back, with no lever or motor.

The set ranks fourth because pairing two real-leather chairs in the $500 to $1,000 bucket makes each seat cheaper than most single leather recliners. Against the CANMOV below, the leather and the second chair justify the premium. It lacks any motorised help, so the raised legs do the work of keeping the seat above floor level.

It works for couples who want a matched reading corner. The overall size is 31 by 41 by 36 inches per chair, so measure your room for two before ordering.
pros: Solid wood legs lift the seat
Push back to recline, no levers
cons: Two chairs need real floor space
products.idealFor: Couples furnishing a reading nook with matching leather.
products.skipIf: You want a single chair or need lift help.

products.name: CANMOV Pushback Recliner Chair Faux Leather Armchair Push Back Recliner with Rivet Decoration, Reddish Brown
products.verdict: One of few pushbacks that lists a 19 inch seat height, so you can check fit before buying.
products.description:
The CANMOV is a pushback recliner in faux leather with a 19 inch seat height, a 22 by 21 inch seat, a 34 by 37 by 40 inch body and a 350 lb rating. It uses an iron frame described as good for more than 25,000 uses, and recline happens when you push the arms and lean back.

It sits one step under the ANJ pair because faux leather and a single chair cost less, but they also age differently, with surface wear showing first on the armrests. It earns its rank over the IOMOR through clearer published dimensions, which matters when seat height is the whole point of buying a high leg model.

Choose it if you want a classic wingback and need to check that 19 inch height against your knee. The listing gives no warranty period, so ask the seller before buying.
pros: Breathable cover is easy to clean
cons: Faux leather can peel with age
products.idealFor: Buyers who want measurable seat height in a classic style.
products.skipIf: You are broad through the hips.

products.name: IOMOR Push Back Recliner Chair Faux Leather Lounge Armchair with Rivet Decoration Wingback
products.verdict: A compact wingback on four wooden legs with the only stated one-year warranty among the pushbacks.
products.description:
The IOMOR reclines from 110 to 160 degrees using body weight, with a footrest that retracts when you press it down. It uses a metal and wood frame, four wooden legs, high-density sponge cushioning and a 350 lb rating, with listed dimensions of 31 by 40 by 30 inches.

It ranks below the CANMOV because the listing does not state a seat height, which is the number a high leg buyer needs most. It beats the EBELLO by pairing a clear weight rating with a stated warranty of one year, so a failed mechanism has a path to replacement.

It fits renters and small rooms where a lift chair is too much. The faux leather is described as breathable, but expect warmth in summer, as with any vinyl-type cover.
pros: Four wooden legs raise the seat
products.idealFor: Small-space buyers who want a warranty on a pushback.
products.skipIf: Seat height is your deciding spec.

products.name: EBELLO Pushback Recliner Chair, Fabric Armchair Push Back Recliner with Rivet Decoration
products.verdict: The cheapest chair here, with a tufted fabric look and little else listed.
products.description:
The EBELLO is the budget entry in the $100 to $200 bucket, a button-tufted fabric wingback with high-resilience foam cushions. It measures 29.1 by 40.6 by 35.5 inches and reclines through a push-back mechanism that extends the footrest.

It lands seventh because the listing publishes no weight rating, no seat height and no frame detail, so you cannot verify the things a high leg buyer cares about. The saving against the IOMOR is real, but you take on the risk of an unknown capacity.

Buy it for a guest room or a lightly used corner where the chair sees short sessions. Do not buy it as a daily chair for a heavier adult until the seller confirms the capacity in writing.
pros: Lowest price bucket in the ranking
products.idealFor: Guest rooms and light, occasional use.
products.skipIf: You need a stated capacity or a daily chair.

products.name: VKNOW Recliner Chair, Fabric Recliner with Adjustable Back, Green
products.verdict: A narrow chair for tight rooms, with the thinnest published detail of the group.
products.description:
The VKNOW is a narrow fabric recliner at 24.4 inches wide, 34.6 inches deep and 40 inches tall, stretching to 65.4 inches when fully extended. It offers four adjustable positions with lumbar support.

It finishes last because the width that makes it easy to place also limits sitting room, and the listing publishes no weight rating, seat height or warranty. Compared with the IOMOR, you save floor space but lose proof of capacity and support terms.

It is a sensible pick for a studio apartment or a bedroom corner. For anyone who needs a high, stable seat, one of the higher-ranked chairs is the safer purchase, and the $200 to $500 bucket buys more specification elsewhere.
products.idealFor: Studio apartments and narrow bedroom corners.
products.skipIf: You need a wide seat or proof of load rating.

methodology.title: Seat height and standing help
methodology.description: We weighted lift motors, published seat height and raised-leg construction most heavily, because easy sit-to-stand is the point of a high leg recliner.

methodology.title: Seat width and depth
methodology.description: We compared listed seat dimensions against the user sizes each chair claims to suit, and penalised listings that omit them.

methodology.title: Frame and weight rating
methodology.description: We read stated load limits, frame materials and cycle ratings, and treated a missing capacity as a risk, not a neutral.

methodology.title: Comfort features and controls
methodology.description: We assessed recline range, heat and vibration, remotes and storage, counting only what the listing actually specifies.

methodology.title: Support and warranty terms
methodology.description: We checked stated warranties, exchange policies and certifications such as TUV and FSC, since recliners fail at the mechanism first.

whatMatters.detail: Seat height is the distance from the floor to the top of the cushion, and it decides how much your knees and hips must work to stand. A higher seat shortens that push. Look for a stated number in the specs, such as 19 inches on the CANMOV, and measure your own knee height to compare.

A power lift chair uses a motor and actuator to raise the seat and tilt you forward. A manual or pushback chair relies on your body weight. If standing hurts, the motor is not a luxury. On a listing, look for the actuator rating, as with the MCombo's TUV certified part.

Width decides whether you sit between the arms or against them, and depth decides whether the seat edge hits behind the knee. The REHOUSING lists 26.5 by 22.25 inches. Compare those figures with a seat you already find comfortable and be wary of listings that give only overall dimensions.

The rating is the load the frame and mechanism are built for, and it protects the footrest linkage as well as the legs. Ratings here run from 350 to 400 lbs. Pick a chair with comfortable headroom above your weight, and treat a listing with no stated capacity as a warning.

A recliner needs clearance behind and in front, and fully extended length is the number most buyers ignore. The Korser reaches 65.1 inches and the VKNOW 65.4 inches when flat. Measure the room, and the walkway to it, before ordering.

faq.q: What makes a recliner a high leg recliner?
faq.a: It either raises the seat on a motor, as the REHOUSING and MCombo do, or it sits on exposed legs so the cushion starts higher, like the ANJ and IOMOR. Either way, the goal is a shorter push when you stand up.

faq.q: Can I use a power lift chair without an outlet nearby?
faq.a: No. The REHOUSING and MCombo both need mains power for the lift motor and the massage and heat. Plan a spot within cord length of a wall socket, and avoid extension cords that could be tripped over.

faq.q: Is a lift chair worth it over a pushback recliner?
faq.a: If standing is hard, yes. The MCombo costs a bucket or two above the pushbacks and adds an actuator doing the work. If you stand easily, a CANMOV or IOMOR gives you the recline without the motor.

faq.q: How hard are these to assemble?
faq.a: The MCombo and Korser both advertise tool-free setup, about 15 and 10 minutes respectively. Pushbacks like the EBELLO attach the back to the seat through metal grooves. A second person helps with any chair over 60 lbs.

faq.q: How do I clean faux leather and fabric recliners?
faq.a: For the MCombo, use a dry or damp lint-free cloth and skip oils or waxes. The ANJ leather wipes clean, while fabric chairs like the Korser and EBELLO need a vacuum and spot cleaning for spills.

faq.q: Can I use a standard height recliner if I am tall?
faq.a: You can, but check the seat height. The CANMOV lists 19 inches, while the MCombo is sized for people up to 5 ft 9 in. Taller sitters should look at the REHOUSING or Korser, both of which are built wider and taller.

finalTake: For most people who struggle to stand from a low chair, the REHOUSING is the right buy, because motorised lift beats any mechanical trick. The MCombo is the sensible alternative at a lower price if you are average height. If you do not need a motor, the Korser has the room and the CANMOV publishes the seat height you need. Only choose the EBELLO or VKNOW when budget or floor space is the limiting factor.
